H6.units: R: tenor's constant-maturity excess return over the window, %; dy: yield change, bp; zS: size known at A-5, sd of the 6 prior same-tenor amounts; SEs clustered by calendar week of A

H7.units: R_m: 10-year T-4..T excess return, %; zA: sd of SA_m (past months only)

H8.model: LS = a + b x zS_pre + c x zD; LS = R_post - R_pre (%), cash constant-maturity excess returns, before costs; SEs clustered by the Monday-Sunday week of A (CR1, normal); p = 1 - Phi(t_c)
H8.statement: H8 fails: across 101 auctions from 2025-07-23 to 2026-09-23, a 1-sd higher primary dealer coupon position at A-5 goes with a -0.021 percentage-point change in the auction long-short return (t = -0.17, one-sided p = 0.566; pass needs c > 0 and p < 0.05).
